newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MRCB says eyes Rashid stake.
newsitem.headline: MRCB says eyes Rashid stake.

text.p: Diversified Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) said on Wednesday it has received approval from the Malaysian central bank to enter into negotiations to acquire a stake in stockbroking firm Rashid Hussain Bhd.
An MRCB statement said that further details on the proposed transaction would be furnished in due course.
The statement confirmed market talk that MRCB was eyeing to buy a stake in Rashid.
MRCB said the suspension of trading in its shares would remain until further notice. MRCB stock, which was suspended on October 23, was last traded at 9.70 ringgit.
Rashid said last week it has entered into negotiations with Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) to buy the bank's entire equity interest in Kwong Yik Bank Bhd.
Maybank, Malaysia's largest banking group, owns a 75 percent equity stake in smallish bank, Kwong Yik.
There has been market speculation that Rashid will inject Kwong Yik into the banking arm of DCB Holdings Bhd.
Rashid holds a 20.4 percent stake in DCB Holdings.
Trading of Maybank, Rashid, DCB and Kwong Yik Bank have been suspended since October 21.
Maybank shares were last traded at 25.00 ringgit, Rashid at 15.80, DCB at 8.65 and Kwong Yik at 6.95.
